source.test: NeoForgeInstaller.latestStableVersion() -- called from install(into:) when no version is given

notes: `stable = versions.filter { !$0.contains("-") }` drops any version containing a hyphen (here just `20.2.12-beta`); the winner among what's left is picked by dotted-numeric compare (`compare`, line 233), which correctly ranks `26.2.0.61` above `26.1.2.95` since 2 > 1 at the second component -- a plain string sort would get this wrong the other direction depending on padding. `raw_metadata_versions` is the real, unmodified `<version>` list from `corpus/providers/neoforge/maven-metadata.xml` (captured P7.3, only 7 entries so no truncation needed here unlike Forge's list).
